review_description: I had a fantastic experience with Magma Electrical for the installation of solar panels, a battery system, and a heat pump hot water unit. Casey helped design a system tailored to both our current and future needs. While Casey was away, Tay quickly stepped in to keep things moving and tie up a few loose ends. Throughout the process, the entire team provided thoughtful recommendations and with Matt jumping in over the weekend to help us understand our options and make the most of our setup, including advice on energy providers and plans.As part of our goal to switch off gas, the team also replaced our existing gas cooktop. They carefully cut into our stone benchtop, followed all necessary safety precautions, and installed our new induction cooktop perfectly.On installation day, the team was extremely professional, kept me informed about when water and power would be temporarily shut off, ensuring minimal disruption to my workday.After installation, Magma handled all inspections and paperwork efficiently, keeping me updated every step of the way. With so many options out there for solar: panels, batteries, system sizes, and installers, it can get overwhelming.One of the main reasons I chose Magma was how easy they made the entire process from start to finish, even helping me source out panels that had just released!I can’t recommend Magma Electrical highly enough!

We highly recommend Matt and the team at Magma Solar. Their quote for the system including battery was the most detailed and most closely reflected our usage and needs. We were very happy with the choice of equipment they offered.They kept us informed through every step of the process leading up to installation and everything happened on time and as planned. Installation was done perfectly and as planned.Regarding grid connection, they organised everything and kept us fully informed throughout the process.Matt even took the time to show us how to set up and use the app to monitor our system. Thank you to Casey, Tay, Matt, Matt, Jordan and the whole team.

Magma Electrical were excellent with communication throughout the whole process from the time of the original quote to post installation, flexible with my particular solar system choices, and pleasant and professional to deal with on the day of installation. Would definitely recommend them.

We got "apples-to-apples" quotes from 5 installers, and Magma came out best, not only in pricing, but also in clarity on matters like potential additional electrical upgrades and foreseeable issues with installation.After the contract was signed, they have specialist individuals to follow up with our queries and were able to provide expedient and accurate answers every time.We commissioned a system of 19.8kWh of panels and 48kWh of batteries. They weren't confident that nstallation could be completed  in one day. As it turned out, it was a rainy day too.  However, they kept pushing on and finished everything the same evening, and even managed to clean up the site before they left.It has been over a month since installation and my VPP subscription is up and running. Magma's electrician Matt has maintained constant contact with me to check on the system, make twitches to improve efficiency, and to give real time advice when necessary.I would highly recommend Magma to anyone looking into Solar.

Great and friendly customer services all the way from initial quote till the final install and commissioning, did what they promised and kept me updated throughout. Company owner Matt was very particular with quality and the Installation team were also great and very professional -very happy.
Casey, Matt and the team at Magma Electrical made the whole process simple and easy.Installation was fantastic, clean and simple.Any questions were answered without issue.

It was a 100% positive experience . The price was $6000 less than one other company for the same equipment exactly and a much larger battery to boot .Casey and the team at Magma Electrical have been outstanding. Friendly, competent and wonderful communication.The installation was done with care and attention to detail. One big positive point for me was that they do not use subcontractors but use their own electricians. I have since asked them to quote on another system -for my holiday house - and they are prepared to travel to regional Victoria to do it. I most highly recommend this company.

I went with Magma because their quote was broken down into individual components and was the most detailed and transparent. Magma were also the first to get back to me and were never pushy.Their prices were also the best and the only ones offering sigenergy battery and inverter.Casey in the office was extremely helpful and efficient. She organised all the rebates and was very helpful when I decided to add a heat pump water system to the quote. Matt the young installer is a credit to his company, polite and patient and explained things clearly. Matt also stayed to make sure the settings on new heat pump hot water service was set up for my needs.Everything is working well and I am running everything from solar at the moment.Matt Jenkinson (the boss?) also said he would help with pricing and installing an EV charger and convection stovetop/oven unit when I am ready.I thoroughly recommend Magma Electrical. Good old fashioned honest service!!

We recently had solar installed by Magma Electrical and we couldn’t be happier with the entire experience! From start to finish, their communication has been absolutely fantastic.Their pricing was extremely competitive, offering great value without compromising on quality. After getting a few quotes, it was clear that Magma Electrical provided the best deal for a quality system within our budget.One thing that really stood out was how genuine and professional they were. We had reached out to other companies, and many of them felt extremely pushy, constantly pressuring us to lock things in. Whenever we asked questions, it was always followed up with, “So are you ready to proceed now?” It felt like they were just desperate to close the deal as quickly as possible. But with Magma, there was none of that, just honest service that gave us the time and information we needed to make an informed decision about one of the biggest investments for our home.On the day, the installation team was an absolute pleasure to deal with. They were professional, friendly and a very efficient group. You can tell they take pride in their work and the final result speaks for itself.Honestly, this was TOP service. If you're considering solar, I highly recommend Magma Electrical.. You won’t be disappointed!

Quoting process was simple and flexible to run through a number of options. Magma came out and did a site visit including climbing up to the roof.  Installation was over 2.5 days (it was a 19kw system and 24kwh of batteries). Everything was a breeze and all of the interactions with the Magma team were brilliant.

Magma Electrical provided the most suitable, quality and cost effective system for my 2 br unit.Communications were excellent and the  installation process was seamless. I'm enjoying seeing the power of the sun reduce my energy costs, in the best environmental way.

Magma were a pleasure to deal with, they responded quickly, took care of all paperwork smoothly and efficiently and most of all installed the system with no fuss.I would happily recommend them to anyone.

Clear and comprehensive written communication articulating the system design and benefits answered all the questions I had without having to askNo fuss installation organised the day/time in advance and turned up on timeVery responsive customer service both before and after installation.  They helped with the end-to-end process while keeping me informed at all stages.

Great communication skills and punctual‘Can do’ attitude rather than being negativeGreat choice of products that work really well togetherLovely system design which looks great on the roof and functions really wellSwitchboard upgrade looks great as well as wiring to inverter and battery

Most of the quotes were pretty much equivalent, all the companies used the Jinko panels and similar inverters.  Also, we were impressed with the information provided by all the companies.   The installation was remarkably soon after we accepted the quote. Just a week later really. The installation was completed in a day, even though they had to work in the rain.   They were ontime, friendly, quiet and polite, and certainly cleaned up any of their offcuts etc and put things back in place after shifting them.The installers helped set up the App to monitor the sytem and got us started, organised the inspection and grid connection.This survey leaves me with a difficult choice, I can't properly rate value for money or quality of system as it has only been operating for 3 days.   So I have only put 3 stars for each, it is not necessarily correct.

Went through a thorough process and Matt from Magma was happy to respond to all queries and walk me through the suggested proposal.Installation and Communication went seamlessly. A couple of minor technical issues were identified by the team before I was even aware, via their monitoring, and was addressed immediately. Site was spotless on completion and the quality of work, cabling etc. looks great.

Magma electrical installed our 10.56 KW solar system 2 weeks ago and we are thrilled with the result. They were communicative, helpful , willing to answer many questions, and had extensive knowledge of the available options. The installation went seamlessly and they organised the grid connection on our behalf. Their overall professionalism and workmanship was outstanding.

Matthew from Magma was knowledgeable in addressing all my questions. He and his team installed in less than a day including an upgrade of the meter box. Very happy with the professionalism. Friendly service. All paperwork and applications to Electricity supplier done for us. Only two weeks in, but seems to be performing as expected.

Magma Electrical provided good information and gave me full confidence to go from casual interest to let's do this, doubling the size of the Solar system from my original thinking, and proceed with the installation without any pressure (I sold to myself).  The Magma team were, and continue to be, very helpful answering my questions (technical and otherwise) and prompt to respond and come out.  A very positive and relatively seamless experience, and I highly recommend Magma based on our experience.  I enjoy checking the mobile App to see how much energy we are making and deciding which system of heating to use during the day.
Excellent customer service Magma electrical  were super efficient and could not be faulted! Such a great bunch of guys! Highly recommended!

Everything from start to finish was exceptional.  Clear professional communication - Matt and Tay answered all my questions and really made an effort to make sure the system met all my needs and would be a perfect fit for my family. Matt did a site visit and used the drone to show me relevant aspects of my roof and the install planning. They really went the extra mile and even completed some additional home electrical work for me on the day of install with no fuss. The installation itself was immaculate and the team very professional and friendly. Afterwards I was walked through what was done during the installation and how to make the most of the system via monitoring. All the paperwork was streamlined and either done for me or I was helped along the way. I have no problem recommending Magma Electrical to anyone who needs solar or electrical work.
Everything was seamless, especially clear communication of facts without unnecessary sales pitches.

From the first contact with Magma they understood what I wanted to achieve long term. i.e. as close as possible to zero annual energy costs.I spent many hours reading articles on Solarquotes and other sources to understand as much as I could before requesting quotes. We have had a 3kw system for many years so I have a good knowledge of how solar works and the benefits.The installation went really well. All the on site people were polite, friendly, punctual and very tidy. The inspector even commented on how good the installation is.Customer service was excellent. Everything was done by Magma. All I have to do is look at the app and see how much energy we're not having to pay for.It will take 12 months to get a really accurate figure on the overall benefit of the new system but I'm confident we'll get what we set out to achieve.

My experience with the installation of solar panels was seamless from start to finish.Solarquotes .com recommended Magma Electrical for a good reason, they were great to deal with and gave me a great quote for a 6.6kw system. Matt and his team of installers were fantastic, quick and efficient, all done in half a day.They organised the grid connection and all the paperwork involved for me.I Highly recommend using solarquotes for getting some quotes and highly recommend Magma Electrical for supply and installation.

The sales quote process was straightforward. Request for amendment was attended to quickly. Installation was neat and tidy with one single unavoidable external conduit that is hardly visible. Magma Electrical took care of all the paperwork.
Very smooth process, Matthew was very helpful and went out of his way for us. Quality products and helpful admin team

With limited knowledge of how solar works, Matt did an awesome job explaining the process which made the decision a hell of a lot easier.The system is in and working well, Matt and his team knocked things over quickly and efficiently, even saving a heap of cables outside the house.Would highly recommend Magma Electrical and Matt to anyone.

Matt and his team were helpful and professional all the way from the initial quote to the installation.  We are very happy and could not recommend Matt and his team highly enough, you cannot go wrong using them.

Matthew from Magma Electrical phoned me once he had the referral through from SolarQuotes, and he clarified a few things I’d mentioned in the quote request, as well as discussing future possible renovations and upgrades we’d be doing to the house. And he did this on a Sunday which was totally unexpected!His quote was actually the best that came through and was the only one which provided the size system we were hoping for.His company also does general electrical work, so after looking them up on Facebook and chatting more to him, as well as having him over to the house for a physical inspection so he could confirm that what we wanted was possible, we went ahead and confirmed our install. He was fabulous for fitting in around our dates (we wanted the solar install, along with a bunch of extra general electrical work, done between when we settled on the house and when we moved in), and his work was fabulous. He and his team were always polite and friendly, hard working and even showed up early in the morning so they could get the majority of the roof/heights work done before the rain kicked in.Absolutely ecstatic with our system, and with both the pre- and post- sales service from Matthew and his team. I was so happy with his work that we’re getting a load more work done with him during renovations over the next few years, and I’ve also referred him on to two other people who are also getting him to install their solar systems.Pick Matthew, you won’t be disappointed!

Matt and the boys did a fabulous job, all the wiring was hidden in the wall cavity.No slick salesmen involved, you deal with Matt and he controls the installation handson.I would certainly recommend Magma Electrical.
